يتيامن (form VI)
# يَتَيَامَنُ (yatayāmanu) /ja.ta.jaː.ma.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
# يَتَيَامَنَّ (yatayāmanna) /ja.ta.jaː.man.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
# يُتَيَامَنُ (yutayāmanu) /ju.ta.jaː.ma.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
